Who will be the next Chief Minister of Bihar — Nitish Kumar, Tejashwi Yadav, Samrat Choudhary, Prashant Kishor, or someone else? The answers to these questions will unfold in the Bihar Assembly Elections 2025.
Before that, The Lallantop went on the ground to understand the real mood of Bihar. In our new series, “Hum Bihar Ke Log”, we spend a day with people from different age groups, communities, and walks of life to know their stories, struggles, and aspirations.
